subject: general
question: A person pays 20% of his monthly salary as monthly payment to repay a loan. He spends 25% of the remaining salary and saves ₹780. Find his monthly salary.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **monthly salary** be 100%.

After paying 20% **loan payment**, remaining = 80%.

He spends 25% of 80% → 20%, so **savings** = 80% − 20% = 60%.

60% = ₹780 ⇒ 1% = 13 ⇒ 100% = ₹1300.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1300.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Loan payment = 20%, Expenditure = 25% of remaining, Savings = ₹780.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8feeadbec56b368d2e068d06e268199365ec08440d8a8843c6c59c9533ac9ed.png] 

Let **Total Salary** be S.

⇒ **Remaining Salary** after loan = S × (1 − 20/100) = 0.80S

⇒ **Savings** = 0.80S × (1 − 25/100) = 0.80S × 0.75

⇒ 780 = 0.60S

⇒ S = 780 ÷ 0.60

⇒ S = 1300

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1300.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Remaining Value Formula

When percentages are calculated on a "remaining" balance, use the formula: Final = Initial × (1 − r₁/100) × (1 − r₂/100).

Successive Percentage Change

The effective percentage change for two successive changes a% and b% is given by (a + b + ab/100)%.

Base Change Property

Always identify the base of the percentage. 25% of the "remaining" is different from 25% of the "total".
